# Sandbox callback evidence — 2026-09-28

Partial P2-01 evidence. Nine actual interactive callbacks are retained in
`2026-09-28-sandbox.jsonl`, and two more in `2026-09-28-diagnostic.jsonl`.
No end-event record was captured. P2-01 remains open for end-event evidence.

## Source and transport

- Africa's Talking web simulator and sandbox account, operated in Brave.
- Initial capture tool at commit `263103b`, localhost port 3101, exposed through a
  temporary Cloudflare HTTPS tunnel. The dashboard callback and events paths
  were independently read back as `/ussd` and `/events` on the same tunnel.
- Caller was synthetic; this run does not establish live Kenyan carrier
  interoperability, deadlines, output budgets, or billing.
- The probe writes sanitized decoded forms, not raw wire bodies. All nine
  accepted requests were POST form-encoded requests with exactly the documented
  five interactive fields and no unknown fields. The two diagnostic callbacks
  have the same field/media shape. Header/charset variations and
  percent-encoding bytes cannot be reconstructed from these records.
- Contract sources: [Handle Sessions](https://developers.africastalking.com/docs/ussd/handle_sessions)
  and [Notifications](https://developers.africastalking.com/docs/ussd/notifications).

## Scenarios and reconciliation

Record numbers below are one-based JSONL line numbers. Aliases are scoped to
this recorder process and have no persisted mapping to original identifiers.

| Records | Session alias | Simulator actions and observations |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1–4 | `sessionId-1` | Dial, choose `1`, choose `1` again, choose `2`. Initial text is empty; transcripts advance to `value-1`, `value-1*value-1`, and `value-1*value-1*value-2`. Three menus rendered, then the terminal probe message displayed. Console independently reported Success, four hops, 46 seconds, no errors, matching three CON responses and one END response. |
| 5 | `sessionId-5` | Separate dial rendered the menu, then CANCEL closed it. Console reported Incomplete, one hop, one second. Only the initial callback was retained; cancellation notification was not observed. |
| 6–9 | `sessionId-6` | Separate dial, `0`, synthetic free text containing an accented character, spaces, ampersand and plus, then `2`. Each callback advanced the cumulative transcript and the final END message displayed. Console reported Success, four hops, 21 seconds. This verifies transport of the back token only; the fixed probe implements no back navigation. Sanitization removes exact text, so this is an operator observation rather than a byte-for-byte encoding fixture. |

The callback records span 09:23:53–09:26:09 UTC (refer to each record for exact
receipt time). The console and simulator observations reconcile their sequence
and responses; `sandbox-capture-verified` means that reconciliation was performed.
`providerAuthenticated` remains false: source authentication was not established.

## Privacy and limits

Session, service, phone, and network fields are stable aliases. Nonempty input
segments are stable value aliases, preserving equality, position, and empty
segments. No raw caller identity, session ID, credentials, account email, input
text, or notification response/metadata is retained. Console screenshots were
not committed because they include account information.

The saved events URL alone does not prove delivery. The initial recorder
persisted only accepted form traffic without rejection counters. A follow-up
in this same run added aggregate counters (see `scripts/lib/sandbox-capture.js`
and its privacy regression test) and restarted the probe without changing the
tunnel or provider URLs. Its separate file has fresh, independent aliases;
`value-1` in that file is the finish selection, not the earlier continuation.

The diagnostic session began at 09:29:34 UTC and displayed END at 09:29:58 UTC.
The provider console confirmed Success, two hops, 24 seconds. At 09:31:15 UTC
the tunnel and recorder were stopped. Shutdown counters were exactly
`{"captured":2,"outcomes":{"/ussd:200":2}}`: no accepted or rejected `/events`
requests reached the probe during this bounded window (77 seconds after END).
This does not establish non-delivery for all later times or identify whether
delivery was prevented upstream of the probe.

Notification delivery, field presence, ordering, retry and authentication
guarantees remain unresolved. A follow-up must establish sandbox event delivery
or obtain provider confirmation of its limitations before P2-01 is marked
complete. Deliberate failure/deadline probes and live operator checks also
remain pending.

The service code is a retained sandbox resource. The temporary tunnel and
recorder are stopped; both URLs must be updated to a running probe before
another run.
